guards.expr: same logical goal && previous PASS_THROUGH && command_available && !failure_latched && !safety_suffix_active; store retention succeeds
PASS_THROUGH && !coincident terminal STOP && !finished && matching epoch/request/junction && MAIN boundary reserve >= minimumMainContinuationReserveNs()
suspended generation equals active bundle; owner epochs match; latest world validates; valid_until >= now; no failure latch; recheck at commit
recovery InitialHold or StoppedRecovery && finite measured speed <= 0.15 m/s && elapsed since first failed current PlanFromRest >= 5 s

contracts.statement: Desired successor identity differs from active predecessor. Eligible retarget retains predecessor until successor commit; active safety suffix queues one newer goal and exact-consumes after commit.
contracts.reachability: Static path and production owner/adapter tests; producer-created full admission not joined in one test.
contracts.counterevidence: Admitted continuation command immediately calls updateMission.
contracts.open: Product reachability of crossing after witness loss and target occurrence unknown.

contracts.statement: Stale world returns without publish and suspends exact active generation. Fresh world recertifies exact owner/rechecks commit. Adapter cache expires independently and can request Hold.
contracts.reachability: Static path plus production helper/store/node fixture tests; no mapping callback to receiver/handover integration test.
contracts.counterevidence: Exact generation/identity/world gates allow resume before receiver lease expiry.
contracts.open: Live profile/timestamps, remaining receiver lease and PX4 acceptance unknown. Adapter source fixes command lease at 0.10 s and state age at 0.20 s; actual remaining lease at suspend depends on the last accepted message timestamps.

contracts.statement: Runtime 5 s steady timer starts on first failed current PlanFromRest and fail-closes only stationary in InitialHold/StoppedRecovery. Adapter 5 s ROS deadline starts on completed endpoint needing recovery.
contracts.reachability: Runtime and adapter portions separately covered by selected production tests.
contracts.counterevidence: Different owner, clock, start event, scope and consumer; equal duration alone proves no conflict.
contracts.open: No shared-budget specification or joint fake-clock test. Adapter 5 s endpoint deadline uses ROS time while runtime retry uses steady time.
